title: Why Ken Paxton’s Estranged Wife Is Making the Case for His Senate Campaign
summary: Angela Paxton is urging Texas voters to support Mr. Paxton’s Senate campaign, even as she is divorcing him and accusing him of adultery. She has political aspirations of her own.
